images.title: Same primes, any order
images.purpose: Show that 3 × 3 × 7 and 3 × 7 × 3 use the same primes, only the order changes.
images.composition: Two equal rows stacked with wide space between them, one label below.
images.exact_structure: Top row: three equal circles in order 3, 3, 7. Bottom row: three equal circles in order 3, 7, 3. In both rows the 3 circles are teal #0072B2 and the 7 circle is amber #E69F00. Below, centred: one label. Exactly 2 rows, 6 circles, 4 teal and 2 amber.

images.takeaway: The same primes appear, only the order differs.
images.description: Two rows of prime circles 3, 3, 7 and 3, 7, 3, each with two teal 3s and one amber 7.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
